text:
Webhook retries are causing duplicate executions, DB inserts, and API calls/emails in your workflow.

This needs an experienced human on the n8n community forum because recommending a production-safe approach requires reviewing your workflow and deployment details.

**Problem:** Repeated webhooks with the same `event_id` run fully; you need deduplication, concurrency protection, and safe retry handling.
**Version and setup:** Version and hosting details not provided; workflow is Webhook → Process Data → HTTP Request → Database.

Bulk uploads leave Google Sheets rows missing despite all n8n executions showing Success; single uploads work.

This needs human investigation because the reported behavior suggests a possible bug, but the cause isn’t established.

Please report it as a likely bug on [n8n-io/n8n’s GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** Simultaneous webhook POSTs carrying media URLs produce fewer sheet rows than expected, while all executions report Success; sequential requests work.
**Version/setup:** n8n version and hosting not provided; Webhook node v2.1 → Google Sheets Append Row node v4.7, mapping `{{ $json.body.secure_url }}` to “Link photo.”

You’re trying to reuse one fetched list of 1,000+ Linear tickets to enrich PRs inside a loop, without fetching it again each time.

This needs a human experienced with n8n workflows because the available excerpts don’t establish how Merge supports this setup; please bring it to the n8n community forum.

Problem: Enrich release PRs using referenced Linear ticket numbers and a reusable ticket list; Merge inside the loop appears to require both inputs active each iteration.
Version and setup: n8n version and hosting not provided; Loop Over Items with PR data and an externally fetched Linear ticket list.

Your agent writes to MongoDB, but a new chat thread doesn’t recall the location from your earlier conversation.

This needs a human because the available documentation doesn’t establish the cross-thread memory behavior you’re asking about.

Please post on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) so an experienced user can review your workflow and clarify supported memory patterns, including semantic, episodic, and procedural memory.

Problem: MongoDB is accessed in a new conversation, but the agent asks which location you mean instead of recalling it; you want clarification and learning resources.
Version and setup: n8n version and hosting not provided; AI Agent with attached MongoDB memory, HTTP Request node, fresh collection, two chat threads.

Your Airtable production webhook runs successfully, but execution results don’t reflect the node changes visible in your editor.

This needs human review because the available documentation doesn’t establish why those results differ from your editor.

Please report this as a suspected bug on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), where a maintainer can investigate.

**Problem:** Airtable-triggered production executions update the record but appear to use older downstream node logic, including null handling; execution and editor screenshots show different results.
**Version/setup:** n8n 2.15.1 on n8n Cloud; database and execution settings managed by Cloud; macOS client.

You want to change your Creator Hub account email but can’t find the setting.

This needs a human to confirm the Creator Hub process, because the available documentation only covers instance owner email changes.

Please ask an experienced person on the n8n community forum to confirm how Creator Hub email changes are handled.

Problem: Change the email address associated with a Creator Hub account; no setting found.
Version and setup: Creator Hub account; n8n version and hosting setup not provided.

Publishing hangs or returns 524 across your Cloud workflows, blocking production webhook registration and Meta verification.

This needs a human because the instance-wide failure requires access to your Cloud workspace and service logs.

Please contact **n8n Cloud support through the support channel available for your plan**, and include this handoff:

**Problem:** All workflows remain on “Publishing…” or return 524, including 60+ node, reduced, and Manual Trigger-only workflows; production webhooks never register, so Meta verification fails.
**Version and setup:** Version not provided; n8n Cloud workspace `bruhmiit.app.n8n.cloud`.

You’re downloading a Google Doc as HTML, but Extract from File returns “No output data returned.”

This needs a human because the information provided doesn’t establish why your Extract from File node produces no output.

Please share this with an experienced community member on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) for workflow review.

**Problem:** Google Drive Download → Extract from File (HTML operation) returns no output when processing a Google Doc.
**Version and setup:** n8n Cloud; n8n version not provided; Google Drive node v3, Extract from File node v1.1.

You need a safe Salesforce ECA credential migration across many workflows, with clarity on bulk updates and the deadline.

This needs a human because the provided documentation doesn’t establish whether credentials can be updated globally or clarify the migration deadline communicated to you.

An experienced person on the n8n community forum is the right contact for this migration-planning question; mention that your support request is still awaiting a reply.

Problem: Salesforce ECA migration across many workflows; global credential-update options and the communicated deadline are unclear.
Version and setup: n8n version and Cloud/self-hosted setup not provided; Salesforce is used in many workflows.

All your Python functions stopped working after updating the n8n app on TrueNAS.

This needs a human to inspect the app’s runner configuration and assess a TrueNAS-compatible resolution rather than assume generic Docker instructions apply.

Please post in the **[n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/)** so someone experienced with TrueNAS deployments can review it.

**Problem:** All Python functions fail after updating; error: “Python runner unavailable: Python 3 is missing from this system.”
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.25.4, installed as a TrueNAS app on TrueNAS 26.0.0-BETA.1; database reported as “17.10”; EXECUTIONS_PROCESS reported as “own ?” (unconfirmed).

You want to use an n8n agent to terminate employees in SAP SuccessFactors.

This needs human review because employee termination changes consequential HR records, and integration support and safeguards must be confirmed before recommending an approach.

Please post on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) so someone experienced with SAP SuccessFactors integrations can review your requirements.

Problem: Confirm whether an n8n agent can handle employee terminations in SAP SuccessFactors and what safeguards are needed.
Version and setup: n8n version, Cloud/self-hosted setup, and SAP SuccessFactors configuration were not provided.

You want to collect WhatsApp messages over about 90 seconds and send them together in one Gmail message.

This needs a human because coordinating storage and timing across separate trigger executions isn’t covered by the supplied documentation.

An experienced workflow builder on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right person to help.

**Problem:** Batch incoming WhatsApp texts over roughly 90 seconds, then consolidate them into one message for Gmail.
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting type not provided; workflow receives WhatsApp messages and sends Gmail output.

You’re seeing an intermittent `reasoning_content` error with AI Agent + DeepSeek, but not with OpenAI.

This needs human investigation to check whether n8n preserves and returns `reasoning_content` during thinking-mode exchanges; the documentation doesn’t establish that behavior.

Please report this as a potential bug in [n8n-io/n8n’s GitHub issues](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** AI Agent + DeepSeek intermittently returns “The reasoning_content in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API”; OpenAI does not.
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting type not provided; using AI Agent with the DeepSeek Chat Model.

You’re building HTML emails with Code and HTML nodes and want to embed an image using the Microsoft Outlook node.

This needs a human to verify Outlook-specific support for hosted images, base64, and CID attachments, because the available documentation covers the Send Email node instead.

Please post this question on the n8n community forum so an experienced Outlook-node user can confirm what’s supported.

Problem: Embed an image in HTML sent through Microsoft Outlook; choosing between a hosted URL, base64, or a CID attachment.
Version and setup: n8n version and hosting setup not provided; workflow uses Code and HTML nodes to build the Outlook email body.

You’re seeing Always Output Data use the Switch’s first output instead of continuing each empty branch.

This needs human review because the documentation doesn’t clarify that behavior in n8n 1.91.3, and it may be a bug.

Please report it on [n8n-io/n8n’s GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), including your shared workflow.

**Problem:** Switch v3.2 reportedly routes empty items through the first output; expected empty `false` and `true` branches to continue alongside the matching `enabled` branch; all matching outputs enabled.
**Version/setup:** n8n 1.91.3; Node.js 22.17.1 on NixOS; SQLite; default EXECUTIONS_PROCESS.

You want to know how hard moving your Zapier workflows to n8n will be and whether you’ll need to rebuild everything.

This needs a human to assess your workflows and migration risks, because the available documentation covers moving workflows within n8n, not migrating from Zapier.

An experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right contact for advice specific to your workflows.

Problem: Assess Zapier-to-n8n migration effort, risks, and whether workflows require rebuilding.
Version and setup: n8n version and hosting setup not provided; currently using Zapier.

Your large-file workflow still slows or crashes despite chunking, streaming, external storage, and smaller stages.

This needs human review because recommending safe large-file and resumable-processing patterns requires examining your workflow and deployment configuration.

An experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right next contact; the information provided doesn’t establish a likely bug or Cloud instance problem.

Problem: Webhook → Download File → Extract/Transform → Upload Result; large CSVs, PDFs, and images cause high memory use, slowdowns/crashes, lingering binary data, and whole-file retries despite prior mitigations.
Version/setup: Not provided; n8n version, database, EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting, hosting method, OS, workflow export, and error/output details remain unknown.

Your WooCommerce credentials work manually, but `get_product` returns no output and shows a credential warning when the subworkflow runs in production.

This needs a human investigation because the execution-dependent behavior suggests a possible bug that the documentation doesn’t explain.

Please report it to the n8n maintainers through a [GitHub issue on n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** AI agent’s subworkflow fails at HTTP Request node `get_product` using predefined WooCommerce credentials in production; manual execution succeeds. Workflow JSON already provided.  
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.16.0, self-hosted with Docker; subworkflow invoked by another workflow.

After deleting a user and transferring their workflows and credentials, only transferred workflows have trouble accessing sub-workflows and data tables.

This needs human investigation because the inconsistent access after transfer suggests a possible bug, and the documentation doesn’t establish an exact fix.

Please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues) so the maintainers can investigate.

**Problem:** Some transferred workflows can’t access sub-workflows or data tables despite correct IDs; newly created workflows work, including when nodes are copied from affected workflows.
**Version/setup:** n8n 2.27.3, Docker on Ubuntu, PostgreSQL; EXECUTIONS_PROCESS not provided.

Your Cohere Chat Model request fails with a v1/v2 error, and OpenAI-compatible alternatives haven’t worked with Basic LLM Chain.

This needs human investigation because the reported endpoint incompatibility may be a node bug, and a supported workaround hasn’t been confirmed.

Please report this likely bug on [n8n-io/n8n GitHub Issues](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** Cohere returns HTTP 400 requesting `/v2/chat` instead of `/v1/chat`; seeking a supported Basic LLM Chain workaround without raw HTTP requests; OpenAI-compatible alternatives failed.  
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.31.0, Docker, Ubuntu 24, PostgreSQL, default `EXECUTIONS_PROCESS`.

You need to recover partially completed production workflows without repeating successful work or losing data.

This needs a human to review checkpoint persistence, retry boundaries, and external API idempotency, because replaying workflows could duplicate actions or lose data.

Please bring this to an experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/).

**Problem:** Designing safe partial-workflow recovery with checkpoints, retries, and manual-review boundaries; external API failures may leave work partially completed. No specific error or workflow export provided.
**Version and setup:** Production n8n with external APIs and potentially large datasets; n8n version, database, EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting, hosting method, and OS not provided.

Your third API call fails after two succeed, and retrying the workflow risks duplicate payment or inventory actions.

This needs human review because a safe recovery recommendation depends on your workflow’s retry behavior, persistent state, and each API’s idempotency guarantees.

Please have an experienced person on the n8n community forum review this production-design question.

**Problem:** Multi-API order workflow partially fails; payment and inventory are tracked as completed, shipping as pending, and you need recovery without repeating successful operations.
**Version and setup:** Not provided; n8n version, database, EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting, hosting method, and operating system are unknown.

The Table view column-focus button disappeared across unrelated workflows after your n8n Cloud upgrade to 2.9.3.

This needs human review to determine whether it’s a UI regression or an intentional change not covered by the documentation.

For this likely UI bug, please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** Node input/output Table view no longer shows the column-focus header button; affects unrelated workflows, with no error message or documented explanation found.
**Version and setup:** n8n Cloud 2.9.3; Firefox 148.0 on Ubuntu Linux.

You’ve got the Slack modal working, but showing a dependent second dropdown has resisted repeated attempts and a review of Slack’s docs.

This needs a human to review your workflow and Slack interaction handling, since the details provided don’t establish what’s preventing the update.

Please post on the **n8n community forum** so someone experienced with Slack modals can review it.

**Problem:** Show a second dropdown containing only child options for the first selection; modal and Slack connection work, but updates haven’t succeeded.
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting setup not provided; using n8n with a Slack modal.

Simultaneous webhook requests leave Google Sheets rows missing, even though all n8n executions show Success.

This needs human investigation because the documentation neither confirms a race condition nor establishes a concurrency-safe fix.

Please report this as a potential bug on [n8n-io/n8n GitHub Issues](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues) for review by the maintainers.

Problem: Single uploads log correctly; bulk simultaneous uploads lose rows in Webhook (POST) → Google Sheets (Append Row), despite successful executions.
Version/setup: n8n version and hosting not provided; Webhook node v2.1, Google Sheets node v4.7; maps `{{ $json.body.secure_url }}` to “Link photo.”

Your published Cloud workflow hasn’t triggered for five days since changing its schedule from every 4 hours to every 8 hours, despite an update and restart.

This needs a human at n8n Cloud support for your Starter plan because investigating your instance’s scheduler registration and logs requires access unavailable here.

Please contact n8n Cloud support through your plan’s support channel.

Problem: Schedule Trigger v1.3, every 8 hours at minute 45, stopped triggering after interval change; other workflows run, execution limits aren’t exceeded, and updating/restarting didn’t help.
Version/setup: n8n 2.6.4, n8n Cloud, Starter (Annual); workflow active/published; macOS client.

Simultaneous uploads leave missing Google Sheets rows even though all n8n executions show Success.

This needs human investigation because the reported behavior suggests a possible bug, but the cause isn’t established.

Please report it on [n8n-io/n8n’s GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues) for review by the maintainers.

Problem: Bulk concurrent POST webhooks → Google Sheets Append Row miss media URLs; individual uploads work, and all executions show Success.
Version and setup: n8n version and hosting not provided; Webhook node v2.1 → Google Sheets node v4.7, mapping `{{ $json.body.secure_url }}` to “Link photo.”

Webhook retries are triggering duplicate executions, database inserts, and API calls/emails in your production workflow.

This needs human review because concurrency-safe deduplication and retry handling depend on your workflow and storage setup, and incorrect guidance could cause duplicate side effects.

Please bring this to an experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) for a production-design review.

**Problem:** Repeated webhooks with the same `event_id` run fully; you need safe deduplication, concurrent-event protection, and retry handling.  
**Version and setup:** Version, database, execution mode, hosting method, and OS not provided; workflow: Webhook → Process Data → HTTP Request → Database.

Your Instagram/Facebook assistant is failing on long conversations and returning unreliable product answers when retrieval tools are skipped.

This needs human investigation because the available documentation doesn’t establish a fix, and failed executions and Gemini 2.5 Flash tool-call traces need review.

For this potential bug, please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues) so a maintainer can investigate.

**Problem:** Long histories cause slow or failed executions; inconsistent tool use and prompt compliance produce incorrect product responses.
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting not provided; Gemini 2.5 Flash AI Agent, Supabase/Hybrid RAG tools, Instagram/Facebook, text and image paths.

You want MP3 transcription with speaker diarization, but can’t pass binary audio to `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize`.

This needs a human because the available documentation covers Whisper, not binary input or diarization setup for this model.

An experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right contact to verify model support and the required setup.

**Problem:** Google Drive MP3 → AI Agent with OpenAI Chat Model `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize`; entering `data` as the prompt returns HTTP 500; binary audio input is unresolved.
**Version/setup:** n8n Cloud 1.123.9; AI Agent v3, OpenAI Chat Model v1.3, Responses API disabled; binary mode `filesystem`.

Your template-based AI Agent chat fails before any visible workflow execution, despite successful credential tests and checks across Gemini and Mistral.

This needs a human to investigate the self-hosted chat execution path because the available documentation has no exact fix for this behavior.

As a likely bug, please report it on [n8n’s GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** First-agent template chat returns “Failed to receive response”; no nodes activate, container logs show no errors, and connectivity and multiple providers were checked.
**Version/setup:** n8n 2.26.2, TrueNAS Scale 25.10 via TrueNAS Apps (Docker unconfirmed), PostgreSQL 18; `EXECUTIONS_PROCESS` unknown.

You want to reuse one fetched list of 1,000+ Linear tickets to enrich PRs in each loop, without fetching the tickets again.

This needs an experienced human on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) because the available documentation doesn’t confirm how to combine that reusable list with each loop iteration in your setup.

**Problem:** Enrich release PRs using their Linear ticket identifiers and a single fetched ticket list; you report that Merge inside the loop requires both inputs to be active each iteration.
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting type not provided; workflow uses PR data, Linear tickets, and Loop Over Items.

You want to bundle ongoing access to your self-hosted n8n instance as a free bonus with a paid AI API subscription.

This needs a human licensing review: contact **license@n8n.io** so n8n’s licensing team can assess whether your model requires a commercial agreement.

**Problem:** Confirm whether inviting paying AI API subscribers to use hosted n8n as a bundled bonus is permitted under the Sustainable Use License.
**Version and setup:** n8n version not provided; self-hosted instance, subscriber access via invitation links, hobby project with no registered company.

“Get many workflows” is missing workflows, returning deleted ones, and showing names that don’t match, despite no filters being set.

This needs human investigation because the documented Return All and filter settings don’t explain these results or establish a refresh delay.

Please report this as a potential bug in [n8n’s GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** Workflow backup using the n8n node’s “Get many workflows” returns incomplete results, deleted workflows, and mismatched names without filters.
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting type not provided; backup workflow uses the n8n node.

Your Confluence request succeeds without pagination, but enabling pagination produces a 401 “Unauthorized; scope does not match.”

This needs a human because explaining the difference requires reviewing the actual returned `_links.next` and resolved next-request URL, neither of which is included here.

The right handoff is an experienced HTTP Request/OAuth user on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/).

**Problem:** Confluence Cloud page-version retrieval fails only with pagination; next URL is configured as `https://api.atlassian.com/ex/confluence/xyz{{ $response.body._links.next }}`.  
**Version/setup:** n8n 2.35.7, self-hosted, SQLite, filesystem binary storage; HTTP Request node v4.4 using generic OAuth2 credentials.

You want to reuse one fetched list of 1,000+ Linear tickets to enrich PRs across loop iterations, without fetching it again.

This needs an experienced person on the **n8n community forum** to review your workflow’s loop and Merge execution, because the documentation doesn’t explicitly cover this cross-iteration reuse.

Problem: Enrich release PRs using a shared Linear ticket list; you report that Merge inside the loop requires both inputs to be active each iteration.
Version/setup: n8n version and hosting setup not provided; workflow uses PR data, Linear tickets, a loop, and Merge.

Your workflow previously accessed Google Drive, but now fails with a granted-scopes/requested-spaces error.

This needs a human to review your credentials and any configuration changes, because the documentation doesn’t provide an exact fix for this error.

An experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right next contact; share your workflow and this handoff there.

**Problem:** Previously working Google Drive access now returns “Forbidden” and “The granted scopes do not give access to all of the requested spaces”; what changed is unknown.
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting not provided; shared workflow uses Google Drive node v3 and Google Docs node v1 with OAuth2.

Your production ECS containers restart every few hours, with SFTP timeouts, database timeout/recovery messages, and SIGTERM events appearing in sequence.

This needs a human investigation because the supplied documentation does not establish how these events relate, what causes the restarts, or an exact fix.

The right handoff is an experienced self-hosting specialist on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/).

**Problem:** Recurring production restarts; SFTP failures precede alternating database timeout/recovery messages and SIGTERM; three CSV log examples supplied.
**Version/setup:** n8n 2.4.8, Business self-hosted Docker on AWS ECS, Postgres on RDS, AWS ELB, `N8N_PROXY_HOPS=1`, Node.js 22.21.1, regular execution mode.

Your Airtable production webhook runs successfully, but the execution’s null-handling output doesn’t match the updated nodes in your editor.

This needs human review because the published workflow version must be checked against the affected execution before treating this as a bug or Cloud instance issue.

Please route this to an experienced person on the **n8n community forum**.

**Problem:** Airtable’s production webhook updates the record, but execution output appears to reflect older Set/HTTP/logic nodes rather than the editor’s latest changes.
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.15.1 on n8n Cloud; Cloud-managed database and execution settings; macOS.

Your published workflow changes appear to take effect immediately, despite the CLI’s restart warning.

This needs a human to verify version- and deployment-specific behavior before advising whether you can safely ignore the warning.

Please report this possible CLI warning bug on GitHub: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues.

Problem: `n8n publish:workflow --id=<workflow-id>` warns that a restart is required, but your test suggests the next execution uses the updated workflow without restarting; you’re asking whether this depends on the 2.x version, runners, or queue mode.
Version and setup: n8n 2.4.8; Docker on Ubuntu; PostgreSQL; `EXECUTIONS_PROCESS=main`; runner and queue-mode usage not specified.

Your previously working MySQL credentials still test successfully, but assigning them to a new MySQL node fails.

This needs a human to investigate why credential testing succeeds while node assignment reports the credential as missing.

As this may be a bug, please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** Previously working workflow; credentials test successfully, but a new MySQL node reports `Credential with ID "tC1TggL2PzLMu8r1" does not exist for type "mySql"` and won’t accept any MySQL credential.  
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting setup not provided; MySQL credentials and a newly created MySQL node are affected.

Your Chat icon is still missing despite an active Community License and both environment variables being set.

This needs a human to confirm Chat Hub’s availability and activation requirements for v2.0.3 and determine whether you’re encountering a bug.

Please raise this as a suspected bug on [n8n-io/n8n’s GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), where maintainers can investigate the version-specific behavior.

**Problem:** Chat Hub sidebar icon missing; Community License active, folders/personal view visible; `N8N_CHAT_HUB_ENABLED=true` and `N8N_RECEPTOR_ENABLED=true` set.  
**Version/setup:** n8n v2.0.3, self-hosted on Elestio.

Your n8n node’s “get all workflows” response is missing workflow descriptions.

This needs a human to verify the expected API and node behavior in 2.36.7, because the documentation doesn’t clarify description availability or edition restrictions.

Please bring this to an experienced contributor on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/).

**Problem:** Workflow descriptions are absent from the n8n node’s workflow-list response; you want to know whether this is a Community Edition restriction or general behavior. Shared node: typeVersion 1, tag filter, `excludePinnedData: true`.
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.36.7, self-hosted Community Edition, SQLite; installation method and execution-process setting unspecified.
